title: Smart112Assessment
description: Contract schema for AI and heuristic triage evaluation of an emergency incident.

incident_id.description: Foreign UUID referencing the parent incident.

assessment_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific assessment run.

extracted_facts.description: Structured facts parsed by NLU/Gemini from caller speech and telemetry.

summary.description: Concise factual summary of the emergency event.

primary_emergency_type.description: Specific nature of emergency (e.g. cardiac arrest, structure fire, armed robbery).

victims_count.description: Estimated count of injured or affected individuals.

weapons_involved.description: Flag indicating if firearms, knives, or dangerous weapons are present.

fire_present.description: Flag indicating active fire or dense smoke.

hazardous_materials.description: Flag indicating chemical, biological, or radioactive hazard.

trapped_persons.description: Flag indicating victims trapped in vehicles or structures.

caller_emotional_state.description: Assessed emotional baseline of the reporting party.

special_instructions.description: Immediate tactical considerations (e.g. access code required, guard dog on premises).

confidence_score.description: Model confidence in triage classification (0.0 to 1.0).

uncertainty_flags.description: Explicit warning flags identifying uncertainty or technical failure points.

needs_review.description: Fail-safe indicator. True if confidence < threshold, uncertainty flags present, or AI timed out.

model_metadata.description: Diagnostic metadata regarding the AI inference pipeline.

engine.description: Name or version of the inference model (e.g. gemini-2.0-flash, heuristic-fallback).

latency_ms.description: Roundtrip latency of the assessment execution in milliseconds.

assessed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of assessment completion.
